name: beecargo
description: Publish files and get durable Beecargo share links via MCP. Connect with Beecargo (OAuth) or a bc_* key — no dashboard login required for bootstrap.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to hosted Beecargo MCP. Agents register a bootstrap key, upload via a public URL or small payload, and return https://beecargo.net/d/{shortId} for humans. OAuth Connect with Beecargo is the recommended auth path; API keys work too.
defaultPrompt: Publish this artifact to Beecargo and give me a share link
Upload a public HTTPS file URL to Beecargo and return /d/{shortId}
Register a Beecargo agent key then publish a share link
